2607.17742.title: Semantically Similar, Logically Distinct: Diagnosing the Semantic-Answerability Gap in Table RAG
2607.17742.paper_summary: Tables are a critical knowledge source in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), but a retrieved table may lack sufficient evidence to answer a query, a property we call answerability. While answerability broadly concerns whether a source or collection of sources contains sufficient evidence, retrieval models optimized for semantic relevance do not guarantee it even in the single-source case, creating a fundamental mismatch. To study this, we introduce TCR-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for Table Content-level Answerability in RAG, built around sibling tables, i.e., tables with highly similar schemas but subtle content differences. On TCR-Bench, the dense retrievers we evaluate persistently exhibit a Semantic-Answerability Gap: they often retrieve the correct sibling group yet struggle to pinpoint the uniquely answerable table within it, dropping QA performance from 0.755 (oracle) to 0.330 (top-5 retrieved). Our analysis suggests this gap is associated with semantic accumulation, schema-level cue dependence, and weak row-column binding. As a diagnostic probe into the source of this gap, we test whether a lightweight two-stage pipeline, Answerability-Aware Reranking (AAR), applying direct query-table answerability judgment, can recover performance: it raises top-1 target retrieval from 18.2% to 57.4%, and this large gain is itself evidence that much of the observed failure reflects a missing answerability verification step, rather than an inherent limitation of model capacity alone.
2607.17742.paper_summary_zh: 表格是檢索增強生成（RAG）中的關鍵知識來源，但檢索到的表格可能缺乏足夠的證據來回答查詢，我們稱之為可回答性。雖然可回答性廣泛關注一個來源或來源集合是否包含足夠的證據，但為語義相關性優化的檢索模型即使在單一來源的情況下也無法保證這一點，從而造成根本的不匹配。為了研究這一點，我們引入了 TCR-Bench，這是一個針對 RAG 中表格內容級別可回答性的診斷基準，圍繞兄弟表格構建，即具有高度相似模式但內容細微差異的表格。在 TCR-Bench 上，我們評估的密集檢索器持續顯示出語義可回答性差距：它們經常檢索到正確的兄弟組，但卻難以確定其中唯一可回答的表格，導致 QA 表現從 0.755（oracle）下降到 0.330（前 5 個檢索結果）。我們的分析表明，這一差距與語義累積、模式級線索依賴性和弱行列綁定有關。作為對這一差距來源的診斷探測，我們測試了一個輕量級的兩階段管道，即可回答性感知重排序（AAR），該管道應用直接的查詢-表格可回答性判斷，以恢復性能：它將前 1 個目標檢索率從 18.2% 提升至 57.4%，而這一大幅增長本身就是證據，表明觀察到的失敗在很大程度上反映了缺失的可回答性驗證步驟，而不僅僅是模型容量的固有限制。
